title: Deflect the Blocker
setup: Black's king hides behind three pawns on the eighth rank while its queen roams far away on c5.
hint: A back-rank check the king has no answer to. Which single black piece can get in the way, and where?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Re8+}} hits the back rank. The king has no squares at all — f7, g7 and h7 are its own pawns — so the queen must interpose with {{Qf8}}. That is the whole point: {{Rxf8#}} removes the blocker and mates on the same square.
